deduction.hypotheses: P_n subset R^d, N_n→infinity, B_n=N_n^(1/d), every pin in P_n sees at most M_n≤B_n^2 positive distances.
deduction.antecedent: Family167 cor:pins, uniform over all planar configurations, taken as stipulated.
deduction.argument: For any fixed 0<epsilon<1, every planar subset Q of size s above a uniform threshold has a pin seeing at least s^(1−epsilon) distances within Q, hence s≤M_n^(1/(1−epsilon)). Smaller subsets are bounded by that threshold. Thus for every delta>0, choosing epsilon with 2/(1−epsilon)<2+delta gives max_plane |P_n intersect plane|≤B_n^(2+delta) eventually. Equivalently the maximum plane occupancy is at most B_n^(2+o(1)).
deduction.checked_use: In secants.tex line314, N B^(2+o(1))(1+log N)^2=o(N^2) for each fixed d≥3. This restores that specific bound when M is a maximum local palette size.
deduction.limits: Does not restore exact C M log M; no full sparse-cones adaptation checked, no equal-distance energy replacement, and no complete proof of the frozen166 pinned target.
